items.label: ALS
items.text: Advanced life support; paramedic chase vehicle, often an SUV

items.label: AT
items.text: Aerial tower; called a tower locally

items.label: REHAB
items.text: Rehabilitation unit; a support vehicle that helps firefighters rest, rehydrate, cool down or warm up, and receive medical monitoring at an incident.
